senses.gloss:
इन्वका^1 A king of star remaining overhead in the मृगशीर्ष-नक्षत्र.
[1] Correction submitted by Scott Rhodes on 20251211. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/102.

इन्व् €6 P.
—1 To go.
—2 To pervade, surround.
—3 To seize, take possession of.
—4 To invigorate, gladden; see इन् also.
इन्वकाः Stars in the head of Orion. (See इल्वकाः)
